Class Cell

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.model.Cell
public class Cell extends Object
Represents a single cell in the world grid. Contains terrain properties, climate data, and resource availability.

Note: This class is designed for GPU compatibility and may be refactored to use flat arrays instead of HashMap for better GPU performance.
